title.narrative: Scale-up of HIV prevention to contribute to reduction of HIV related morbidity and mortality by 2026 - Cameroon (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Cameroon, HIV, Ministry of Public Health of the Republic of Cameroon (NACC)This program has the following goals: Réduire la morbidité et la mortalité liée au VIH/Reduce HIV-related morbidity and mortality. Attémuer le fardeau socio-écononomique du VIH sur le développement du pays/Mitigating the social and economic burden of HIV on the country's development. The objectives of this program are: Les nouvelles infections à VIH/IST/HV sont réduites d’au moins 70%, en particulier parmi les populations les plus exposées entre 2022 et 2026/New HIV infections are reduced by 70% between 2022 and 2026 especially among the most exposed populations.. La mortalité liée au VIH est reduite de 50% entre 2022 et 2026/HIV-related mortality is reduced by 50% between 2022 and 2026. La transmission du VIH de la mère à l'enfant à 6 semaines est réduite à moins de 2% entre 2022 et 2026/Mother-to-child transmission of HIV at 6 weeks is reduced to less than 2% between 2022 and 2026

Percentage of people living with HIV

Number of new HIV infections per 1000 uninfected population
Number of AIDS-related deaths per 100,000 population

Percentage of people living with HIV who know their HIV status at the end of the reporting period
Percentage of HIV-positive results among the total HIV tests

Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART who are virologically suppressed

Percentage of people living with HIV and currently on antiretroviral therapy who are receiving multi month dispensing of antiretroviral medicine
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART with viral load test result
Percentage of adults (15 and above) on ART among all adults living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
Percentage of women accessing antenatal care services who were tested for syphilis
Number of individual HIV self-test kits distributed
Percentage of people living with HIV newly initiated on ART who were screened for TB
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Percentage of people on ART among all people living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
